assets.spec: Short ledge, width about twice its depth; a chunky left shoulder tapering toward a pointed lower-right tip.
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated full-color 2D side-view cavern walkway stamp for a painted platform game.
Reference image: attached game screenshot is STYLE AND STONE MATERIAL REFERENCE ONLY. Match its angular fractured cave rocks, muted blue-gray slate, broad hand-painted facets, dark crevices and restrained pale upper-left edge highlights. Do not reproduce screenshot, buildings, character, HUD or sky.
Subject: ONE solid natural cavern outcropping whose upper edge was carved into a perfectly straight horizontal walking ledge. Top contour level across its entire width, narrow lightly tooled top lip integrated into the SAME bedrock. All other contour edges irregular angular natural fractured rock, asymmetric projecting masses and broken underside. Rock faces made of broad angular interlocking planes, natural fracture scale. Carved face may have subtle chisel marks. NO separate paving slab, NO brickwork, NO stacked masonry, NO round cobbles, NO grass, NO ground shadow.
Camera: orthographic side elevation, very little visible top surface, no perspective foreshortening. Painted game sprite, crisp readable silhouette. Background genuinely transparent alpha, no scenery, no labels. Entire stone fits comfortably in frame with transparent margin on every side.
Specific silhouette: Short ledge, width about twice its depth; a chunky left shoulder tapering toward a pointed lower-right tip.
assets.correction: Edit the reference rock stamp. Preserve its blue-gray painted angular rock material, lighting, transparent background and side elevation. Correct the upper outline: cut away the raised rock on the far LEFT so the ENTIRE top contour is one straight horizontal level walking edge from the far left to far right. Nothing projects above this edge. Make the shape a shorter compact outcropping by shortening the long RIGHT extension, retaining its deep jagged left underside. Width about twice height. The flat top is carved directly from bedrock; remove the continuous horizontal joint just below the lip so there is no separate capstone course. Subtle short chisel strokes on the upper face. Other edges jagged. One isolated sprite, generous transparent margins, no text.
